reason: It isn't open yet, so I'm not paying a monthly membership for something I haven't seen. The zoo is free and works fine for us, and my first worry is a 5-year-old charging around my baby in a room that's supposed to be calm.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Nothing here says the under-1s get their own space or that anyone enforces a calm-room rule.
would_change_my_mind: A separate baby area or set baby-only hours, plus a visit after it opens (a free trial or a $12 drop-in) where I can see how the room really behaves. After that I'd probably start with drop-ins and look at the membership.
